description:
Initial release with the patches:

List:

Peafowl Theme Maker for EMUI - h7.hamzio.emuithemeotg - GMS_27.5.1 - Allows to buy all the theme - Apply [Nai64Patches](https://github.com/Nai64/Nai64Patches) with the universal premium patch to activate pro
Pillo - xyz.rtrvr.pillo - 0.6.19 - Hybrid lock-screen notifications: fullscreen while locked, banner while unlocked. - Select Pillo's Banner/Light mode after applying the patch. The patch replaces the original app-foreground predicate. - Apply [Doom's patches](https://github.com/rushiranpise/morphe-patches) with the `Unlock Premium` for premium
